get.description: Phase 02 compatibility contract: completed merchandise sales under its original tax-exclusive convention, without refund or customer shipping adjustments. Use /api/finance/summary for VAT-aware financial reporting and completeness indicators.
Historical demo-store financial metrics. Money and percentages are decimal strings; unknown dependent metrics are null. See docs/phase-03-financial-engine.md for definitions.

One consistent demo-store summary, daily series, product performance, and expense breakdown. All money and percentages use the Phase 03 Decimal engine. Rolling periods include the current store-local day. Custom dates are inclusive and limited to 366 days. No parameters selects the synthetic demo period.

post.description: Read-only hypothetical aggregate scenario for the configured demo store. Dates are inclusive and limited to 366 days. Scenario amounts use decimal strings in the store currency. Conversion is an explicit user assumption or the exact historical ratio; it is not predicted. Incomplete or unsupported baselines return status unavailable with null projections and warnings. Invalid parameters, including an advertising change that makes its budget negative, return 422.

Compare two to four named hypothetical scenarios against one shared historical baseline. The baseline is loaded once in the read-only snapshot transaction. All financial projections reuse the existing aggregate-v1 simulation engine; no real-world experiment or automatic ranking occurs. Responses retain the full baseline, its deterministic SHA-256 fingerprint, applied parameters and scenario IDs. Missing inputs return unavailable scenario results. Undefined percentage changes are null. Invalid parameters or duplicate scenario IDs return 422.

Search at most 625 deterministic strategy candidates against one read-only demo-store financial snapshot. Prices, discounts and optional spend are decisions; conversion, traffic and unit cost remain explicit fixed assumptions. No causal demand response is inferred. Return up to three highest operating-profit feasible grid candidates, or an explicit target_not_achievable/unavailable status. Percentage goals require positive baseline operating profit. Money uses Decimal strings and targets round upward to cents; searches above the requested cap return 422.

Stateless AI interpretation with two validated read-only demo-store tools. Financial answers are authored from existing service results; model prose is never displayed. No store selector, record changes, conversation persistence, or real-world experiments.
